This page covers two ranges: Chromogenic Culture Media with UriSelect4 for testing pathogens of urinary tract infections, and Blood Agar Media based on Columbia Agar.

Chromogenic Culture Media is a Bio-Rad range of chromogenic media for culturing and recognizing microorganisms in clinical specimens. The catalog describes UriSelect4, a non-selective chromogenic agar medium for isolating, differentiating and counting microorganisms associated with urinary tract infections. It is supplied as ready-to-use plates and as a dry medium for preparation.

items.text: Blood Agar Media is a Bio-Rad range of nutrient media for primary isolation and culture of microorganisms from clinical specimens. It includes ready-to-use Columbia Agar plates with 5% sheep blood, the Columbia CNA Agar variant for selective isolation of fastidious Gram-positive organisms from polymicrobial specimens, and dry Columbia Agar for preparation in the laboratory.

T10_faq.h2: Questions and answers about culture media

items.q: Which Bio-Rad culture media ranges are shown on this page?
items.a: Chromogenic Culture Media with UriSelect4, and Blood Agar Media, which includes Columbia Agar with sheep blood, Columbia CNA Agar and dry Columbia Agar.

items.q: What is UriSelect4 medium used for?
items.a: UriSelect4 is a non-selective chromogenic agar medium for isolating, differentiating and counting microorganisms associated with urinary tract infections. According to Bio-Rad, results are interpreted within 18–24 hours of incubation.

items.q: How does Columbia CNA Agar differ from Columbia Agar with sheep blood?
items.a: Columbia CNA Agar + 5% Sheep Blood contains colistin and nalidixic acid for selective isolation of fastidious Gram-positive organisms from polymicrobial specimens. Columbia Agar with sheep blood allows hemolytic reactions to be observed.
Ready-to-use plates come in packs of 20 plates of 90 mm (UriSelect4 also in 100). Dry Columbia Agar and UriSelect4 come in 500 g and 5 kg packs.

items.q: Who supplies Bio-Rad culture media in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is an official Bio-Rad distributor in Ukraine. The company helps select the most effective solution for your needs, supplies products and provides application support.
